{{Otheruses|Fondor}}
The '''Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights''' was the ancient ruling body of the industrialized [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] and the accompanying [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. The guild was a minor member of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] but contributed little to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' war effort since many members objected to the Separatist cause.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] Fondor around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], but the Guild was allowed to remain in power to oversee the construction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]'s [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Hosh Hune]] worked for the Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
